## 🧪 How was it tested?

<!-- Pages you checked, browsers and devices you used, anything a reviewer should try. -->


## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Checked at phone (390px), tablet (768px) and desktop (1440px) widths, with no sideways scrolling
- [ ] No errors in the browser console
- [ ] Design changes: compared side by side with the Figma design
- [ ] Images optimized (JPEG ~80% quality, ideally under 400 KB)
- [ ] `DOCS.md` updated if behavior, setup or content rules changed
- [ ] Studio changes: `npm run deploy` run from `studio/`, and `scripts/fetch-content.mjs` updated if the site uses the new fields

## 🔒 Privacy check

- [ ] No private student data (emails, phone numbers, demographics) and no secrets (passwords, tokens, the deploy hook URL) are included in this pull request
